symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: docx_text() in harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py read only w:t, w:tab, w:br/w:cr and w:noBreakHyphen, so it dropped every Word <w:sym> character. This compilation sets three characters that way in the Symbol font: F0B4 (the multiplication sign) once and F0B8 (the division sign) twice. cth_convert_sym.py maps Symbol-font characters to their Unicode characters (· × − • ≤ ≥ ° ′ — ÷ ±), Wingdings boxes to "[ ]", and private-use code points U+F0xx the same way; none of the last two occur here.
